TENET5 started as a MAID evidence project. It then pulled the wider government record and added a live news desk. Those layers got mixed. This page is the map so you can analyze without drowning .
Briefing, LIVE station, press wire, newsletter, day packages. Time-sensitive. Not a finished dossier.
MAID, procurement, interference, parliament — by subject desk. Tables and primary cites.
The original argument: intent, killing, harm, conditions, coercion. Separate from daily news.
What was cited, who published it, the link to check it yourself. Narrative stays off this shelf.
